name: 95608 · Carmichael, CA
findings: ZIP 95608 (Carmichael) has 223 nonprofit organizations. 125 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 92 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95608 (Carmichael) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
